group.name: Quiksilver
group.concept: A team of third-year Artificial Intelligence Engineering and Data Science students from Bangkok University. We bring together Backend Development, Frontend Design, AI Engineering, and DevOps to build practical technology solutions.
highlights: Three members with complementary skills in Backend, Frontend, AI, and DevOps.
Building an AI-powered group portfolio that answers questions about team members and projects.
Combining software development, data, and AI to solve practical problems.

projects.title: TEAMSPACE AI - Group Portfolio
projects.description: An AI-powered group portfolio website that introduces Quiksilver, showcases member profiles and projects, and allows visitors to ask questions through an AI chatbot.

projects.title: Digital Asset KYC & AML Transaction Monitoring System
projects.description: A digital asset exchange management database covering customer KYC, account management, transaction monitoring, and AML risk analysis. The project includes 22 database tables, 7 analytical views, 16 analytical SQL queries, and an LLM-powered natural-language query interface.

members.name: อัสสชิ บัวชุม
members.bio: Third-year student in Artificial Intelligence Engineering and Data Science at Bangkok University. Interested in applying AI and data to practical systems, including web applications, robotics, and data analytics. Enjoys learning through hands-on projects, from setting up development environments to deploying applications.

projects.title: Hotel Management System - AIE313
projects.description: A hotel management web application covering room reservations, parking, and restaurant management, with an AI chat interface that retrieves information from the database.

projects.title: ROS2 Person Detection and Odometry
projects.description: A TurtleBot3 robotics system using two ROS2 nodes: a YOLO-based person detection server and an odometry client. Includes a custom DetectPerson service, safety stop functionality, and CSV logging.

projects.title: Service Robot Kiosk
projects.description: A web-based user interface for a service robot, featuring AutoRun, bill payment, information display, and administrator settings.

projects.title: Vehicle Routing Problem Solver
projects.description: An individual project implementing Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem algorithms, including Nearest Neighbor, Clarke and Wright Savings, Improved Clarke and Wright, 2-opt, Relocate, and Swap, without relying on OR-Tools.

projects.title: Hotel Booking Demand Dashboard
projects.description: An analysis of more than 100,000 hotel booking records from Kaggle, including data cleaning, business questions, and dashboard development.

members.name: ศวิตา โตประสิทธิ์
members.bio: Third-year student in Artificial Intelligence Engineering and Data Science at Bangkok University. Interested in user experience, interface design, and frontend development. Enjoys combining technology and design to create digital products that are visually appealing and easy to use.

projects.title: SMA - Smurf Mechanical Arm
projects.description: A robotic arm project designed to act as an intelligent camera operator, performing precise movements and capturing cinematic shots. Responsible for UX/UI design, frontend development, and photobooth frame graphics.

projects.title: PDPA Hackathon
projects.description: Participated in a hackathon focused on personal data protection, learning about PDPA requirements and how to apply privacy considerations to software and database design.

Interested in applying data-driven approaches to business strategy, marketing, and machine learning. Focuses on building AI applications, data systems, and reliable development and deployment workflows.
